author: reek
body: Proves the metagame analysis. A matchup matrix records each deck's win rate against every other; field-winrates averages each row into a single number, and meta-spread reads the format's health from the gap between the best and worst decks. A rock-paper-scissors field -- every deck 50% overall -- has zero spread and reads as balanced; a field warped toward one deck shows a wide spread and names the dominant archetype. The matrices here are hand-built so the arithmetic is exact; the solver fills the same grid from real games via matchup-matrix.
